For the file, two choices: “Light, without the photos” (small, easy to send, perfect in the same database; elsewhere the missing photos become notes) or “Complete, with the photos” (heavier, but complete everywhere: on import, the missing photos, sounds and PDFs are added to the database). “＋ Add → Import a board” reopens this file as a new board; the links are kept when it is the same database. The zoom (the percentage) has a menu: fit to selection, fit content to the window, 50 / 100 / 200 %.
0yax62e: How do I merge spreadsheet cells?

Click a cell, then ⇧ + click on another: the cells between the two are selected. On the right: “⊞ Merge” (the texts are joined end to end in the first), “⊟ Split” to undo it; the fill is applied to all the selected cells.
170fm9m: Which brushes and erasers are there in a board?

✍︎ tool (P), then the brush button: Pen, Monoline, Marker, Pencil (grain), Pastel, Fountain pen (the line gets thinner when you go fast), Reed pen (bevelled tip), Brush, Watercolour, Fill (the traced shape is filled), Highlighter, Chalk, Neon, Airbrush, Dotted. At the top of the menu, five ready-made thicknesses; next to them, the exact thickness in px and a colour of your choice. ⌫ tool (E): “Fine eraser” erases only what it touches (the line is cut), with its size in px; “Stroke eraser” removes the whole line. A drawing already made can change brush in the right panel.
1hx0xnf: How do I put a spreadsheet in a board?

▦ tool (G) then click, or “＋ Add” → A spreadsheet. Double-click a cell to write; Enter goes down, Tab moves to the next one (and adds a row at the end), Esc cancels. Formulas: =B2+B3, =SOMME(B2:B9), =MOYENNE, =MIN, =MAX, =NB, =PRODUIT, =ARRONDI(B2;1)… (English names such as SUM also work). Paste a piece of Excel or Numbers into a cell: it fits into the grid. On the right: add or remove rows and columns, column width, header row and column, every other row shaded, cell fill, download as CSV.
1igz6uf: How do I see what is grouped in a board?

Each group has a coloured dotted frame and a badge “Group n · number of items”: click the badge to select the whole group (and move it by dragging). The ⧉ button near the zoom shows or hides the frames.
0vgj8kd: How do I take a snapshot of a board, or make a new board from another one?

At the top of the board: “📸 Snapshots” freezes the board as it is (give it a name). Later, “Go back to this state” (the current state is kept as a snapshot first, nothing is lost), or “Make it a board” to create a separate one. “⧉ Copy” immediately creates a new board with the current content, with or without the same arrangement. In addition, the app automatically keeps one “⏱ automatic version” per working day (the last 30), stored separately and folded at the bottom of the list of snapshots.
152jeh7: How do I place an automatic tree in a board?

“＋ Add” → “🌳 An automatic tree”: choose the person, then their ancestors, their descendants or their close family (parents, siblings, spouses, children), the number of generations, with or without spouses, arrows or lines. The records are placed linked and grouped (next to what is already there); each card stays linked to its record: double-click to open it.
0ker4xm: How do I put a timeline or a map in a board?

“＋ Add” → “🗓 A live timeline”: a person’s dated events (or those of their couple and children) place themselves on a time line, and follow the record. “🗺 A map”: the places of a person, their family or the person of an investigation; on the right, “Place a marker” adds your own points (a commune, a place), and “link the places in order” draws the route.
1xbdinw: How do I choose what a record shows on a board?

Choose the record placed: on the right, “The record shows”: photo, full dates, years, places, occupation, age, parents. Everything is read again from the record each time the board opens: if you correct a date, the card follows.
1fs4859: How do I mark a lead as to check, confirmed or false?

Choose a note: on the right, “Investigation lead” → ❓ To check, ✅ Confirmed or ❌ False. The note takes the colour of its state and a badge. At the top of the board, “❓ n to check” counts the remaining leads: a click takes you to the next one.
0bn089y: How do I put a comment on an item of a board?

Choose the item → “💬 Comment” on the right. Choose a word for the bubble (To check, Question, Idea, Source?, Important…) or “＋ another word…” for your own (it is kept in your list, “My words” to remove some). A small bubble appears on the item; a click on it reopens the comments, which you tick when they are settled.
1ay0yox: How do I make areas (frames) on a board?

“＋ Add” → “▭ A frame” (if there is a selection, the frame surrounds it). Give it a name (“Paternal branch”, “Sources to see”): what is entirely inside moves with it. ▾ at the top left folds it (its content is hidden, the number of items stays shown); ▸ unfolds it.
1c8urfn: How do I align or distribute several items?

Choose several (⇧ + click or by dragging in empty space): on the right, “Align” (left, centre, right, top, middle, bottom) and “Distribute” (same gap horizontally or vertically, same width, same height). The 🧲 button at the top turns on the snapping grid: while dragging, items snap to the grid and to the edges and middles of the others (pink lines show them); ⌥ / Alt to do without it for a moment.
1cssqgm: How do I use the layers of a board?

At the top: 🗂 Layers → “＋ New layer”. The circle chooses the layer where new items go; 👁 shows or hides it (even in exported images), 🔒 locks it (it can no longer be selected), ↑ brings it to the front, ⬚ selects what it contains. “Put the selection on the chosen layer” moves items; on the right, “Layer” too.
172uob6: How do I search in a board?

At the top: 🔍 (or ⌘F): type a word or a name. It searches the notes, texts, spreadsheets, record names, comments and markers. Click a result (or Enter, ⇧ + Enter to go back): the board goes there and shows it; a folded frame opens, a hidden layer is shown.
0tpkl96: How do I get a board’s mini-map?

At the top: 🗺 shows or hides it (also the × on it). The whole board in small, the current view in red: click or drag inside to move around. Drag its title bar to put it where you like: it stays there.
00a6ftq: How do I present a board?

At the top: “▶ Present” → “＋ The current view as a step” (zoom and frame first), “＋ The selection as a step” or “＋ One step per frame”. “☰ The steps” to rename them, put them back in order, review them. “▶ Start”: full screen, the board glides from one step to the next (→ or space to go forward, ← to go back, Esc to finish). Without steps, the frames are used as steps.
05a7jpt: How do I make an arrow in several segments, one that goes around, or a ready-made “brother of”?

Choose the line: the small “＋” in the middle of each segment can be dragged to bend it (a blue elbow appears; double-click it to remove it). “Line shape” → “⤳ goes around items”: the arrow passes around whatever is in its way. “Ready-made link” (on the right, or in the bar of the Arrow tool before drawing): brother of, sister of, husband of, wife of, father of, daughter of, cousin of, godfather of, witness of, wrote to, same person?… with its caption, colour and style.
0fnjh7v: What happens when I paste an Excel table or a list onto a board?

Paste (⌘V) onto the board: for several lines, the app asks what it should become: a spreadsheet (for a piece of Excel or Numbers), one note per line, one note per spreadsheet row, or a single text. The notes are arranged in a grid, next to what is already there, and grouped if you like.
1x38psr: How do I make my own board templates?
In a board: “⤓ Export” → “⭐ Make it a template” (the whole board or the selection, with or without the texts). It appears in “New board”, under “My templates”; the × on a template deletes it.
1c97ixi: How do I duplicate an item on a board by dragging it (as in Photoshop)?

Hold down ⌥ Option (Mac) or Alt (PC) and drag the item (or the selection): a copy goes with the mouse, the original stays in place. A frame takes along a copy of what it contains. ⌥ + click without dragging copies nothing.
10zinyw: How do I choose a font’s weight (Light, Medium, Bold…) on a board?

Choose the text: on the right, under “Font”, “Weight”. By default, the nine usual weights (Thin 100 to Black 900). Click 🖥 (the computer’s fonts): the list then shows the weights the font really has (e.g. Futura Std: Light, Book, Medium, Heavy…). The B button switches back to normal / bold.
1l6ui93: How do I create my own arrowheads?

Settings → Boards → ➤ Arrowheads → “＋ Create an arrowhead”: from a shape (look for it among all the shapes, yours included) or drawn with the pen; rotate it (0°, 90°, 180°, 270°), filled or outlined, attached by the tip, the middle or the back; give it a name. It is added to the list (with a preview of each arrowhead), where you arrange, hide or delete it (🗑). The app also offers 26 arrowheads: triangle (filled or empty), thin or long arrow, double chevron, circle, square, diamond, cross, plus, star, heart, crow’s foot…
1lvl46q: How do I set the colours and settings of line captions?

Settings → Boards → 🎨 Colours: three categories “Line captions” (text, frame fill, frame border). → ☰ Menus and options: “Settings of a line caption”: the order of these settings and those to hide (size, font, bold, colours, frame, position, side, distance, angle).
0pq27nq: How do I record a voice memo on a board?

“＋ Add” → “🎙 A voice memo” → ⏺ Record, then ⏹ Stop: you can listen to it again, give it a title, then “Place on the board”. The sound is stored with the board and in the app’s media. The first time, the computer asks for access to the microphone.
0c6yt1f: How do I link a board to a person, an investigation, a part of an investigation…?

Under the title of the board: “🔗 Link…” → a person, an investigation, a search sweep, a Workshop project, a collection, a place (its commune), a media item, a label, a family (a couple), an event, an animal or another board, with, if you like, the name of a part (lead 1, the witnesses…). You can add several; × to remove one. The board then also appears on the person’s record (“Boards” block) and in the linked investigation, search sweep or project. “change” next to where it is filed moves the board itself.
1n2vugz: How do I make a free-form board (like Freeform)?

Investigations → “Boards” tab → “＋ New board” (empty, evidence wall, mind map, timeline, hand-drawn tree). Tools at the top: text, note, shapes, line, arrow (it follows what it connects), freehand drawing, eraser; “＋ Add” places a file (image, GIF, sound, video, PDF), a media item from the app, an image or a website from the web, a record, an app screen (with a live preview), one of your widgets, a collection, a label, a folder (a board within the board). Drag or paste images directly. ⌘G group, ⌘L lock, ⌘D duplicate, ⌘Z undo. Everything saves itself.
149peud: How do I put a board in an investigation, a search sweep or the Workshop?

In the investigation (or the search sweep, or the project), “🧩 Boards” section → “＋ New board here”. Give it a part (“Lead 1”) to have several. For a board already made: at the top of the board, “change” next to where it is filed.
1818sjm: How do I transcribe a family record book?

Lists → “Family record books” → “＋ New record book”: issue, marriage, husband and wife with their parents, children, annotations, full transcription and photos of the pages. Link each person to their record (or “create the record”); the record book then appears on the record. “Carry over to the records” adds what is missing (births, deaths, marriage, the couple’s children) without overwriting anything.
0l5a3bf: How do I retouch a photo precisely?

Viewer → Retouch: zoom (⌘ + wheel, + −, 1:1), move around with the space bar. The healing brush and the stamp have a size ([ and ] keys) and a hardness; “🎯 Choose the spot to copy from” for the stamp. Brush (6 kinds) and text go on layers, above the photo. The “History” tab lets you go back to any step.
0wuygp0: How do I fill in an employer’s record?

Lists → Employers → “🏢 Create the record” (or click on the employer in a census, or “🏢 This employer’s record” under the Employer field). Identity, head office, managers, establishments, timeline, notes and sources; “Fill from the Annuaire des entreprises” fills in, in one click, a company that exists (or has existed since the 1970s). The record also shows the family who worked there.
1to2r8j: In what formats can I save an edited sound?

Sound workshop (✂️ Edit) → Save: MP3 (plays everywhere, quality from 96 to 320 kbit/s), WAV or FLAC (lossless), Ogg Opus (the lightest), AIFF (Mac). You can switch to mono, change the sample rate, and “Only download the file” without changing anything in the database.
0gbt8rc: How do I add photos or scans?
In the Media block of the record (“＋” button). For a whole folder that fills up by itself (scanner, phone): Settings → Watched “Scans” folder.
1920jze: How do I brighten or retouch an old photo?

Open the photo, then “🎚️ Retouch”: brightness, contrast, shadows, colours, black and white, sepia, negative and a curve as in Photoshop. “Replace the photo” always keeps the original (“Back to the original”); “Save a copy” adds the retouched version alongside.
080cfew: How do I request a recent record from the town hall?
Lists → Letter register → “Records to request from the town hall”: the letter is prepared, and a reminder can be set for the day the record becomes public.
0b0tdzg: How do I arrange the pages of a photographed register or notebook?
Lists → Collections: the pages in order, with their transcription, a cover image, a table per page (to paste from a spreadsheet) and lines linked to the records.
0lguiwv: How do I go through a census or a register page by page?
Lists → Surveys: the views of the scan alongside, the people arranged by household with the household’s address, and a padlock 🔒 so that nothing is changed by mistake once the page has been checked.
11r0tz8: How do I listen to a recording or cut a video?
Lists → Audio or Videos: player with speed from 0.10× to 6×. “✂️ Edit” opens the sound and video workshop (cut, enhance, assemble); the original is always kept.
0mx2ryq: How do I combine several photos into a single image?
Lists → Media (or the viewer) → “🧩 Assemble photos”: resize, rotate, set the transparency.
0fobilp: How do I prepare a book, a thesis or an exhibition?
Investigations → Research workshop: projects with nested folders, references imported from Zotero, CSL JSON or EndNote, exports to Word, PDF and CSL JSON.
13j4sfs: How do I find out what language a record is written in, or write in Cyrillic or Greek?

Settings → Calendar / measures → “Alphabets and languages of records”. “🔤 A language” shows the alphabet of 40 languages (accented letters, old letters such as the long s ſ, Latin abbreviations, transliteration of Cyrillic, Greek, Hebrew and Arabic) and how to recognise it. “🔎 Which language?”: type a letter or a word from the record (ł, ő, ж, natus…), the possible languages are shown, the most likely first. “⌨️ Cyrillic and Greek”: a small keyboard to write a name, copy it and read it in Latin letters.
1704p2v: How do I convert an old date (Republican calendar, Julian…)?
Settings → Calendar / measures → “Convert a date”: 26 calendars, including the Republican, the Julian, the Roman (calends, nones, ides) and the English Old Style.
06bno85: It is installed only once: Settings → Handwriting recognition (HTR). A 3-step assistant says what is missing and why: ① the engine (Kraken, with a ready-made Python that the app downloads itself: nothing for you to install), ② the handwriting model, ③ the check (“✓ Ready: handwriting reading”). If there is a problem, the message says what to do depending on your computer (Mac, Windows, Linux), then “↻ Try again”.
110jy3b: Read the record: how do I automatically read a handwritten record?

In the transcription workshop (“📜 Workshop” on an image, or Lists → Editing tools → “📜 Record transcription”): “✨ Read the record”. The app finds the lines and reads the whole page, or only the chosen area (draw it with ▭, then “✨ Read this area”). Reading happens in the background, on your computer, without the Internet: you can keep working (“■ Stop” to interrupt it). Then the text is offered line by line next to its piece of image; uncertain words are highlighted in yellow: click them to correct them, Enter goes to the next line. “✓ Put the lines in the text” adds them (with one area per line), then names, dates and places are spotted by themselves. “↻ Read again with this model” tries another model.
1s65kze: Which handwriting model should I choose to read my records?

Settings → Handwriting recognition (HTR), step ②: “McCATMuS” (recommended) for parish registers and French civil registration from the 17th to the 19th century, letters and today’s handwriting; “CATMuS Medieval” for Latin and old scripts (before 1500). Each model downloads in one click from its official source (zenodo.org); its licence (CC BY 4.0: free, crediting the authors) is read at the source and the file is checked by its fingerprint before being kept. For other languages, add a .mlmodel file by hand (“📁 Choose the file…”).
1o1rhgd: How do I uninstall handwriting reading?

Settings → Handwriting recognition (HTR) → “🗑 Uninstall…”: the engine (≈ 1.5 GB) is deleted from the data folder; you can keep the models to reinstall faster. Transcriptions already made stay. A single model is removed with “🗑 Remove” (and “↶ Undo” puts it back).
1i6qpwt: How do I make a backup?

Settings → “🗓 Automatic backup”: “💾 Back up now” (or ⌘⇧B) makes one straight away, and the page sets up the copies made automatically. The full backup with all the media in a single file, password-protected if you like, is in Settings → Clean export.
0202r1v: How do I set up automatic backup (every day, on a USB stick, in iCloud or Dropbox)?

Settings → “🗓 Automatic backup”. When: every N hours, every day or every week, and “Also when closing the app” (only if something has changed). Where: write the folder (a USB stick, an external disk, or an iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive… folder: it is just a folder, the app uses no online service); empty = in the app’s folder, on the same disk. What: how many copies to keep (10 at first: the oldest automatic copy is deleted), with or without the media (copied once, then only the new ones), and all your genealogies if you have several (each in its subfolder). Each copy is a clean snapshot of the database, checked (integrity check) before it gets its name. Everything is kept by itself; “↶ Undo” in the message at the bottom left. If the stick is unplugged, a message says so, without blocking anything, and the copy is made as soon as it comes back. “Last backup: …” is shown at the top of the page and in the dashboard’s “🗓 Automatic backup” widget.
0xq1wed: How do I go back to a backup?

Settings → “🗓 Automatic backup” → “The copies”: each copy shows its date, its size and “CHECKED” (or “DAMAGED”). “↺ Go back to this copy” replaces your genealogy with this one, after a question (it cannot be undone with one click). Your previous database is first kept in the backups, under a name ending in “avant-restauration”, never deleted by itself: you can go back to it the same way. A damaged copy is refused.
1dg0q03: How do I have my genealogy on two computers (the laptop and the office one)?

Settings → Working together → “🔄 Two computers”. Choose a shared folder: a USB stick, or an iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive… folder (no server, no online service from the app), then “🔗 Link this folder”: the app puts a starting copy there, “depart.db”. On the other computer, open “depart.db” (start screen → Import a file, or a new empty genealogy), then choose the same folder at the same place. After that, “🔄 Synchronise” (or automatically on opening and every 15 minutes): each computer drops its changes in the folder and takes those of the other — records, families, events, places, notes, sources, citations, media (with the photo file). Just after, “↶ Undo” puts everything back as before; the undone changes are “set aside” and “Review” lets you choose them one by one. Not yet exchanged: the other tools (Workshop, boards, houses, animal tracking…) and the app settings.
1t6edug: Two computers: the same record was changed on both sides, what should I do?

Everything else is merged by itself; only these records wait for you in Settings → Working together → “🔄 Two computers”, side by side: your version on the left, the other computer’s on the right, only what differs. “Keep mine” (your version goes back to the other one), “Take the other” (it replaces yours), and for a note, “Keep both” (the other’s note is added alongside, with the name of its computer in the title). “↶ Undo” in the message at the bottom left if you made a mistake.
14yiq1y: The app says “Genealogy open elsewhere”: what should I do?

Your database is stored in a folder that two computers can see (iCloud, Dropbox, a network drive…) and the other computer has opened it: if both wrote to this file at the same time, it could be damaged. Close the app on the other computer, then “↻ Try again”. If the other computer is off or the app stopped abruptly there, “Open anyway” (the app also does it by itself after 5 minutes without any sign of life). To really work in two places, use “🔄 Two computers”: each keeps its own database, and changes go through a shared folder.
0ac9wrm: How do I send the tree to the family without risk of it being changed (Share with the family)?

Settings → Export → “📤 Share with the family…”: choose the branches (nothing = the whole database), what happens to living people (hidden, or first name only) and what is shown (photos, records, notes). The summary “Here is what goes out” updates before the .zip file is made. The family unzips it and opens index.html with a double-click: the tree, the records, the photos and the search, without the app or the Internet, and nothing can be changed. Confidential records never go out, nor a photo showing a living person; the full name of a living person written in a note is replaced by “[name removed]”.
1rkltto: How do I keep a copy at a cousin’s?
Settings → Copy at a cousin’s: the copy is encrypted, they keep it without being able to read it and give it back to you if your computer breaks down.
1i2qwms: How do I ask a cousin or an aunt for their memories?

Lists → 💬 Questions for relatives → “＋ New questionnaire” (or “💬 Ask questions about her” on a record, or “💬 Questionnaire” in the Directory of the living). Choose the recipient, a title, a welcome message and ready-made questions (childhood, house and village, occupations, war, celebrations, recipes, photos “Who is in this photo?”, a specific person) or your own; arrange them with ⠿. On the right, the preview as your relative will see it. “⤓ Download the questionnaire” makes a single .html file to attach to an e-mail (“📋 Copy the message” gives the text): it opens in their browser, without the Internet, keeps their answers as they go, and “⤓ Save my answers” gives them a small file to send back to you. “🖨 Printable version”: lines to answer by hand.
0q4v3sc: How do I bring a relative’s answers into my genealogy?

Lists → 💬 Questions for relatives → “⤒ Import the answers”: drop the .json file they sent back, then choose for each answer where it goes: “💬 Testimony” on the record of the person concerned (“Testimonies / memories” block), “📖 Family memory” (recipe, tradition, story…) or “Do not import”. Their name and the date go automatically into “Where it comes from”. An answer received by plain e-mail: “✎ Paste an answer” on the questionnaire’s page. “↶ Undo” removes everything that has just come in. Only files from a questionnaire you sent are accepted.
04ckmjv: How do two people work on the same genealogy?
Settings → Working together: you start from the same database, then exchange packages of changes, accepted or refused one by one.
0vvfxyd: How do I make a short video montage?

Lists → 🎬 Videos → “🎬 Montage” (far right), or “✂️ Edit” on a video. Five tracks: 🎬 Video 1 (the clips one after another, each with its transition: cross-fade, through black, through white), 🖼️ Video 2 (a video inset in a corner), 🔤 Texts (still or moving titles: fade, slide, rise, grow, scrolling credits, typewriter; font, size, colour, banner, position), 🎵 Sound 1 and Sound 2 (music, voice). “🔊 Detach the sound” puts a clip’s sound on a separate track, to move it, lower it or remove it. 🎨 Colours tab: brightness, contrast, saturation, temperature, tint and ready-made styles (Old film, Black and white…), for the whole film or a single clip. Click the timeline to position yourself, drag the insets, texts and sounds. “⤓ Export the video…” replays the montage and makes a file of it (MP4 or WebM); “💾 Save the project” keeps the montage to continue it later.
1p3ni3a: How do I save a montage to continue it later?

In the montage: “💾 Save the project” (or ⌘S; ⇧⌘S for a copy under another name). Files imported from the computer are then sent to Media. To reopen it: “📂 Projects…” at the bottom of the montage, or Lists → Videos → “🎬 Montage”, which offers your projects (open, rename, delete) or a new montage. “⤓ Export the video…” makes the video file, without closing the montage.
1l7gbx4: How do I speed up or slow down a video or a sound in the montage?

Choose the clip on the timeline, 🎯 Item tab → “Speed”: from 0.25 × to 4 × (or the 0.5 × 1 × 1.5 × 2 × buttons). The clip gets longer or shorter on the timeline; “keep the pitch of the voice” avoids the duck voice.
03y2kp2: How do I make a photo last as long as I want in the montage?
Choose the photo on the timeline, 🎯 Item tab → “Time on screen”: type the seconds (for example 5, or 12.5), or click 2 s, 3 s, 5 s, 8 s, 10 s, 15 s.
15qagap: How do I adjust the sound of a single clip, or of the whole montage?

One clip: choose it, 🎯 Item tab → “🔊 Sound of this clip”: clearer voice, less hiss, bass, treble, mono (and volume, fades for a sound). “Apply to all the sounds of the project” copies these settings everywhere. The whole film at once: 🔊 Sound tab (same settings, plus the overall volume and “without sound”).
0g4eit4: How do I undo in the montage?
⌘Z undoes the last change (cut with B, move, adjust…), ⇧⌘Z redoes it; also the ↶ ↷ buttons at the start of the toolbar.
0wnwask: How do I zoom in an editor (retouching, drawing, layout, house, montage…)?

All editors have the same bar at the bottom: on the right “− 100 % ▾ +”. Click the percentage for “Fit to window”, 50 %, 100 % or 200 %. With the keyboard: ⌘ + and ⌘ − (Ctrl on a PC), ⌘ 0 to fit, ⌘ 1 for 100 %; or ⌘ + the mouse wheel. On the left of this bar: where you are (page, layer, slide…); in the middle: help for the chosen tool.
0f7ezs7: What is 🧲 at the bottom of an editor for?

🧲 Snap: while dragging, objects stick to others, to the edges, to the guides or to the grid. Click 🧲 to turn it on or off; the tooltip tells you which key to hold down to do without it for one gesture. 📏 next to it shows or hides the rulers and guides (when the editor has them).
0ccv4ic: Where have the tools and the “Save…” buttons at the bottom of the editors gone?

The tools are in the narrow column on the left (same place in all editors; hover over them for their name and key). The ways of saving (show this version, without showing it, separate copy, keep in media…) are at the top: click ▾ next to “💾 Save”.
1wgq4lh: How do I arrange a list with the keyboard?

Each line that can be arranged has a grey ⠿ handle on the left: drag it, or go to it with Tab and press Alt + ↑ or Alt + ↓ (⌥ on a Mac). In Appearance, the order is saved straight away (“✓ Saved”, and “↶ Undo” at the bottom left).
0jc3cp2: Do record transcription and quick retouching have “Undo”?

Yes: ↶ and ↷ at the top (or ⌘Z and ⇧⌘Z) undo and redo everything: text, title, areas, image settings, retouches. In a text box, ⌘Z first undoes what you have just typed. The File, Edit, Tools and View menus are also at the top.
1k14cjj: Can I have the calculator directly on the dashboard?

Yes: in the left column of the Dashboard, add the “🧮 Calculator” widget with ＋. Type your calculation and press Enter; the last 5 calculations stay below (click to reuse them, ↑ for the last one). “⛶ Open the calculator” opens the big calculator (scientific, graphs).
15eb36v: Where has the events’ 📅 “＋ Add to my calendar” button gone?
It is hidden by default. To show it on the events of records: open My diary → ⚙️ Settings, then tick “Show the 📅 ＋ Add to my calendar button on record events”. The change is kept straight away.
0m24cnw: The settings of My diary or of books no longer have a “Save” button: is that normal?

Yes: each change is kept straight away (“✓ Saved” at the top of the window), and “↶ Undo” at the bottom left undoes it. “↺ Reset to default” puts back the original settings, without a question. “Close” closes the window.
0k2szxa: How do I set my own shortcuts in the montage, sound, retouching or layout?

Settings → “Montage, retouching, layout and sound” → ⌨️ Your own shortcuts (or Settings → Keyboard shortcuts, at the bottom). Choose the tool at the top, then “Choose” next to the command and press the key. A key already taken by the system (macOS, Windows, Linux) or by the application menu is refused; if it is already used in the tool, you are warned and your shortcut takes priority. Without ⌘ / Ctrl, it only works outside text boxes. ✕ removes a shortcut.
1vapvxy: Layout: how do I apply, remove or replace a master on a page?

Pages panel → Masters: the “Page N” list changes the master of the current page (or “No master” to remove it). “Several pages…” (also in the Page menu) does it on all pages, a range, the left or right pages, or replaces one master by another wherever it is. When you delete a master, you choose the one its pages take. ⌘Z undoes.
0908ff9: How do I make a note built the same way again (same order of blocks)?

In the note: “⧉ Duplicate”, then “▦ The same order of blocks” (a new note with the same blocks, titles, widths and colours, but empty) or “⭐ Make it a template” (you can also keep the texts, dates, links and people; images do not go into a template). Your templates appear in “New note”, under “Start from”, in “⭐ My templates” (✎ to edit it, 🗑 to delete it), and at the bottom of “My notes”. Deleting a template does not change the notes already created with it.
0zl7fps: How do I come back later to a sound I am working on?

In “Edit the sound”: “💾 Save the project” (at the bottom left, or ⌘S; ⇧⌘S for a copy under another name) keeps the sound in progress, without loss, separately from Media. To come back to it: “📂 Projects…” in “Edit the sound”, Lists → 🎧 Audio → “📂 Sound projects”, or Lists → 🛠️ Editing tools → 🎧 Sound. To start one: Lists → 🎧 Audio → “＋ New sound project” (a sound from the database or from the computer). When the sound is finished, “💾 Save…” makes a version, a copy or a new sound of it.
0rf1yh2: What is “⚡ Quick sound” and how do I get it?

A window with big buttons to clean up a sound in two minutes: 🧹 hiss, ✨ clicks and crackles, 〰️ mains hum (found by itself, 50 or 60 Hz), 🗣️ clearer voice, 📏 even volume, ✂️ start and end trimmed (black handles on the waveform), ⏩ silences shortened; strength Gentle / Medium / Strong; “✨ Clean everything at once”. By default, “✂️ Edit” on a sound keeps the previous editor (“🎧 Edit the sound”); for the new one: Settings → Montage, retouching, layout and sound → 🎧 Sound → “⚡ Quick sound: the design” → “New ⚡ Quick sound” (kept by itself). Three choices: “As before” (the original editor, each tool with its name), “As before, tidied” (the same, tools in a column on the left and bottom bar shared with the other editors) and “New ⚡ Quick sound”. Nothing is damaged until you have saved: the original stays in the versions.
0i56705: How do I compare the sound before and after cleaning?

In ⚡ Quick sound: 👂 Before / ✨ After, at the same place in playback (the sound continues, you only switch), or hold down the A key to hear the before. In 🎚️ Sound studio, holding A plays the sound without the rack’s effects.
1p66ybp: The full version, in the style of Adobe Audition: waveform with selection, overview of the whole sound, zoom, 🚩 markers and named coloured regions, VU meters, clickable history ↶ ↷; an effects rack you can adjust at any time (graphic and parametric equalisers, compressor, limiter, noise reduction with a noise print, De-clicker, De-hum, De-esser, reverb, speed and pitch, normalise, even volume, fades with 4 curves): ⠿ to arrange, 👁 to switch off, × to remove, “Only on the selection”; the spectrum and its repair brush; Multitrack; transcription. You get there with “🎚️ Sound studio” in Quick sound (or the previous editor), or Lists → 🛠️ Editing tools → 🎧 Sound → “＋ New sound project”.
10tnlrz: I switch from Quick sound to Sound studio: do I lose my settings?

No, the work follows: each button switched on becomes an effect in the rack, already set; the trimmed start and end become cuts of the waveform (in the history). When you go back (“⚡ Quick sound”), what Quick sound can show comes back as buttons; the rest stays applied and a badge says so (“2 Studio settings remain applied”). The last choice is remembered: “✂️ Edit” reopens the same one.
04022g4: How do I remove a cough or a ringtone in the middle of a sentence?

In 🎚️ Sound studio, “Spectrum” switch on: the cough shows as a bright patch. Take 🖌 (brush, B key) or ➰ (lasso), paint over the patch, then “🩹 Repair”: it is replaced by what surrounds it, without touching the words around it. Each repair is in the rack and the history (it can be removed).
11u81wa: How do I link a passage of a sound to a person? Where can it be heard afterwards?

In 🎚️ Sound studio: select the passage, “＋ New region” (or M), give it a name; then in “🔗 Link this passage” choose the person (the usual picker, with a role: speaks, sings, tells…) and, if you like, an event. Right-click a region: “🔗 Link to a person…”. On the person’s record, the “🎧 Heard here” block lists their passages: ▶ plays just that passage.
06ye6y5: How do I transcribe what is said in a sound?

In 🎚️ Sound studio, Window → 📝 Transcription: listen, “⏱ Insert the time” (⌘T) and type what is said, with who is speaking. “🐢 Play at 75 %” slows it down, “Pause while I type” stops playback while you type. Clicking a time plays that passage. The text is searchable, and can be exported as .txt, .srt or .vtt (⤓ Export → 📝 Text and markers). Automatic transcription (an engine on the computer) will come later.
0wbmr4n: How do I make a “family podcast” with music under the voice?

🎚️ Sound studio → “🎛️ Multitrack” tab: Voice, Music, Sound effects tracks (and others), with volume, pan, M (mute), S (solo), ● (arm to record from the microphone). “＋ Add a sound…” places a sound on a track (or drag it from “Files”). Turn on “🔉 Lower the music under the voice”: the music goes down by itself when the voice speaks. The yellow line is the volume curve: drag its ◆ points, double-click to add one, right-click to remove one.
0dpggsv: How do I rescue an old cassette step by step?

Lists → 🛠️ Editing tools → 🎧 Sound → “🧭 Rescue an old cassette”: choose the sound, then follow the steps (listen, hiss, hum and clicks, voice, start and end, save). Each step switches on the right button; compare with 👂 Before / ✨ After.
149rlzm: How do I record a sound from the microphone?

Lists → 🛠️ Editing tools → 🎧 Sound → “🎙️ Record from the microphone”: ● Start, then ⏹; the sound goes into the media and opens in 🎚️ Sound studio. In the Studio, ● (under the waveform) records at the orange marker; in Multitrack, on the armed track ●.
0f6bfuu: Which formats can I export a sound in?

⤓ Export: MP3 (plays everywhere), M4A (iPhone, iTunes — only if your browser can do it), WAV, FLAC (lossless), Ogg Opus (the lightest), AIFF (GarageBand, Logic), 📝 Text and markers (.txt, .srt, .vtt, .cue). You choose the quality, “What” (everything, the selection, each region in a file, each track in a file), the channels and the sample rate; “Write the regions and people into the file” puts the title and chapters into the MP3 or FLAC.
0um4u1c: How do I keep my sound settings for the next cassette?

“💾 Saved settings” (in Quick sound and in the Studio rack): three ready-made sets (📼 1970s cassette, 🎙 Dictaphone, 💒 1987 wedding video) and your own (“＋ Save current settings”), shared between both windows; ⋯ to rename, duplicate, export, delete; ⤒ Import.
12hwy13: How do I clean the sound of a piece of the video montage?

In the 🎬 montage, choose the sound on the timeline, 🎯 Item tab → “🔊 Sound of this piece” → “🎚️ Open in Sound studio”. Clean it, then 💾 ▾ → “Save and show this version”: it comes back clean in the montage. The other way round, Sound studio has File → “🎬 Open in the montage” to put pictures on a sound.
0n2c9vd: How do I separate the sound and the picture of a video in the montage?

Choose the video on the timeline, 🎯 Item tab → “🔊 Separate sound from picture” (or “🔊 Detach sound” in the bar): the sound goes onto a sound track of its own, and can be moved, cut or adjusted on its own; the picture becomes silent. To take only the sound of a video: 🎞️ Rushes tab → “＋ Sound only”, or drag the video onto a sound track.
1okarmn: Where does a rush dragged onto the montage timeline land?

On the track at the height of the mouse. On Video 1, it slots in between the pieces, where you drop it; on an overlay or sound track, at the moment where you drop it. A video keeps its sound, even as an overlay.
019bj29: How do I rename a rush in the montage?
🎞️ Rushes tab: ✎ under the rush. The new name shows on the timeline and in the saved project.
1fmsh89: What is the 🎞️ Rushes tab of the montage for?

These are the videos, photos and sounds of the project. “⤒ Import” (several files at once) or “🗂 From the database”: they wait there, with their length, without going onto the timeline straight away. Drag a rush onto a track (video, overlay, sound) where you want it, or use “＋ Add after”, “＋ Overlay”, “＋ Sound”. The blue number says how many times it is on the timeline; ✕ removes an unused rush.
11m82nx: How do I set up the video montage (layout, buttons, export)?

Settings → “Montage, retouching, layout and sound”: the settings panel on the right or the left, the height of the picture and tracks, the help, the colour of the blocks on the timeline (main video, overlays, texts, sounds); the default export (MP4 or WebM, size: same as the video, 4K, 1080p, 720p, 480p, 360p; quality; frames per second; sound); the buttons and options of each editor (montage, retouching, sound), ticked or not and ordered; full screen on opening. When you save a video, you can still change the size, quality and frames per second.
12tgla3: What is the “Notes” tab for and how do I show it?

A note is a page on a subject: “Poland before the Napoleonic wars”, a place, a trade, a custom… The tab is hidden at first: Settings → Appearance → “Main menu order”, tick “Notes”. “＋ New note”: a title, an icon, and a starting point (History topic, A place, A trade or an empty note).
1sptd85: What can I put in a note?

“＋ Block”: 📝 a text (# title, ## subtitle, - list, **bold**, *italic*, __underline__, [link](https://…), > quote), 🖼️ images and documents (from the computer or already in the app; as a mosaic, large or as a banner), 👥 people from the database, 📅 a timeline of dates, ❝ a quote and its source, 🔗 links, ➖ a subheading, 📺 a screen of the app (map, tree, list, My lists, statistic, a person’s record, village…) and 📊 a widget or chart of your own. “✏️ Arrange”: order with ↑ ↓, choose the width (¼ to full width), duplicate, delete; ✎ on a block to edit it; a colour per block or for the note. “🖨 Print” turns it into a clean page.
0jwcsss: How many tracks can a montage have? How do I add or delete them?

As many as you like, of video, text and sound. Under the timeline: “＋ Video track”, “＋ Text track”, “＋ Sound track”. Adding an overlay, a text or a sound at the same moment as another creates an extra track on its own. To the left of each track: 👁 hide it (neither seen nor heard), ↑ ↓ move it (a higher video track goes in front), 🗑 delete it (straight away, with its items: “↶ Undo” in the message at the bottom brings it back, like ⌘Z), double-click its name to rename it. Drag an item from one track to another of the same kind, or choose its track in the “🎯 Item” tab.
0ktvcji: How do I shrink and move an overlaid video or a text in the montage?

On the picture: click the overlay (Video 2 track) or the text, then drag it; pull the small square in the bottom right corner to make it bigger or smaller. The exact settings (width, position, size) are also in the “🎯 Item” tab.
1d61ctp: How do I zoom with the keyboard?
⌘ + and ⌘ −, ⌘ 0 to go back: in the montage this zooms the timeline; in “Edit the sound”, the waveform; in Retouch, the photo. Elsewhere, the whole page of the app gets bigger or smaller.
04nx7o9: How do I put retouching, sound or the montage in full screen?
The ⛶ button at the top right of the window (as for the boards); it is kept for next time. Settings → “Montage, retouching, layout and sound” also lets you choose full screen on opening.
1pssdhc: How do I order or hide the buttons of Retouch, sound or the montage?

In the window, “⚙️ Customise”: tick what is shown and order with ↑ ↓ (or by dragging ⠿) the tools, options, settings, playback buttons… Kept for next time; “↺ Reset to default” goes back to the original buttons.
17aj58z: How do I put a photo in a video montage?

“＋ Video / photo after” adds a video or photo (from the database or the computer) to the Video 1 track; “＋ Overlay” puts it in a corner. A photo stays 5 s on screen at first: “Duration on screen” in the Item tab.
1w1jgd8: How do I move a montage item to another track, or remove it?

Drag it onto a track of the same kind: a video or photo goes from the Video 1 track to an overlay track (and back), a text onto another text track, a sound onto another sound track. ⌫ (Backspace) or Delete removes the chosen item, B cuts it at the playhead.
1hf8q5e: How do I animate a video or photo (keyframes) in the montage?

Choose the item, 🎯 Item tab → “🎛️ Picture settings” (as in Final Cut): Compositing (opacity, blend mode), Transform (position, rotation, scale, X and Y scale, anchor), Crop, Distort, Spatial conform. Place the playhead, click ◇: a keyframe; go further, change the value: a second one. Between the two, the value changes smoothly (or evenly). ◀ ◆ and ◆ ▶ jump from one keyframe to the next.
03bgydh: How do I keep several montage layouts or several sets of buttons?
Settings → “Montage, retouching, layout and sound”: “💾 Saved settings” for the montage layout and for the buttons of each editor. Give a name, apply, delete, export or import a .json file.
0bjz3kl: What tools does Retouch have (Photoshop style)?

A menu at the top (File, Edit, Image, Layer, Select, Filter, View) and a column of tools to the right of the photo: ➤ move, ⬚ ◯ selections, ➰ lasso, ✒︎ pen, 🪄 automatic selection, ⌗ crop and straighten, 🩹 healing, 🧬 clone stamp, 🖌 brush, ⬜ shapes, T text, ✋ hand, 🔍 zoom. The photo itself is a layer (visibility, opacity, mask). The original is never changed.
0pg8src: How do I select part of a photo in Retouch?

Tools ⬚ (rectangle), ◯ (oval), ➰ (freehand lasso), ✒︎ (pen: point by point, Enter or double-click to close) or 🪄 (click a colour: neighbouring points of a similar shade; set the tolerance). ⇧ adds, ⌥ removes. Select menu: all, none, invert, feather, expand, contract. The selection can then go onto a layer (⌘J), be filled, erased (⌫: transparent), used as a mask or for cropping.
0uh08x9: How do I save a retouch to continue it later?

In Retouch: “💾 Save the project” (bottom left, ⌘S, or File → Save the project; ⇧⌘S for a copy under another name). Everything is kept: corrections, settings, filters, cropping, layers, groups, adjustment layers, masks and selection. To pick it up again: “📂 Projects…” at the bottom of Retouch, or Lists → Media → “Retouch” → “📂 Projects”. The buttons “Save and show this version”, “Save without showing it” and “Separate copy” make the final image.
01bor33: How do I get more room for the photo in Retouch?

The ⇥ button at the top right of the panel (Settings, Filters, Layers, History) folds it; ⇤ opens it again (also the Tab key, or View → Fold / open the panel). This is kept for next time. You can also widen the panel by dragging its edge.
06k5vx3: Does the montage have a menu like Retouch?

Yes, next to the title: File (save the project, projects, export the video), Edit (undo, redo, cut here, starts and ends here, forward, back, separate the sound, remove), Add (import rushes, a rush from the database, video or photo after, overlay, title, sound), Tracks, Playback (play, to the start, keyframes) and View (tabs, timeline zoom, full screen).
06ii2cu: How do I make the small track buttons in the montage (👁 🔓 ↑ ↓ 🗑) bigger?

In the montage: View → “Track buttons: bigger” (or smaller, or starting size); it is kept straight away, with “↶ Undo” in the message. Or Settings → “Montage, retouching, layout and sound” → 🎬 Montage layout → “Size of track buttons” (from 16 to 44 px). The column of track names widens with them.
1cx8vpq: How do I change the “B = cut” key (or Space, ⌫) in the montage?

In the montage: Edit → “⌨️ Montage shortcuts…” (or Settings → Keyboard shortcuts, 🎬 Video montage tab): click the command, press the key you want. If you give another key to “✂️ Cut here”, “▶ Play / pause” or “🗑 Remove the chosen item”, the original key (B, Space, ⌫) no longer does that action: it is free. The menus, tooltips and the help at the bottom show your key.
0wiczdm: In the montage, what is the difference between “💾 Save” and “⤓ Export”?

“💾 Save” keeps the montage project (tracks, cuts, titles) so you can reopen it and continue later; its ▾ menu also offers “Save the project under another name…” and “Keep in media (make the video)…”. “⤓ Export ▾” makes a file (MP4, WebM, sound only MP3 or WAV, subtitles) in the common export window, with a copy in the media if you want.
125upau: Can I use my computer’s fonts for the montage titles?

Yes: choose the title, 🎯 Item tab → “Font”: the common font list opens (search, recent, fonts of the app and of the computer; fonts already used in this film come first). If the browser asks, “🔓 See all the computer’s fonts”. The font is also used in the exported video; on another computer that does not have it, a similar font replaces it.
13aa9ik: Can the track buttons of the video editor be small, medium or large?

Yes: in the video editor, Display → “Track buttons: small” or “large” (“default size” = medium, as before); or Settings → “Editing, retouching, layout and sound” → 🎬 Video editor layout → the “Small”, “Medium (default)” and “Large” buttons under “Track button size”. It is kept straight away, with “↶ Undo” in the message.
0l585kw: How do I make a clip’s sound rise or fall over time in the video editor?

Choose the clip (video, overlay or sound), 🎯 Item tab → “📈 Volume over time”: set the fade-in and fade-out, then “✎ Place points on the clip”. On the clip, in the timeline: a click places a point (at the top: louder, up to twice as loud; in the middle: the set volume; at the bottom: silence), drag a point to move it, a double-click removes it. “＋ Point at the playhead” places one where you are; “✕ Clear the curve” removes them all (with “↶ Undo”). The curve is used for the preview, the exported video and the standard volume (LUFS).
1627yjl: What effects can I put on the sound of a clip in the video editor?

🎯 Item tab → “🔊 Sound of this clip” (or the 🔊 Sound tab for the whole film): clearer voice, less hiss, bass, treble, mono, “🗜 More even volume” (quiet passages come up, loud ones go down), “⛪ Reverb” (a room, a large hall, a church, a cellar) and “↔ Left ↔ right”. These are the same effects as in 🎧 Sound and the 🎚️ Sound studio (a single engine). “↺ Reset to default” removes them; there is also one for the colours of a clip, the colours of the whole film and the sound of the whole film, with “↶ Undo” in the message.
0qriibt: How do I arrange the settings of the video editor’s right panel?

Each tab (🎯 Item, 🎨 Colours, 🔊 Sound, 🎞️ Film) is made of sections that you fold or open with a click on their title. To change their order: drag the ⠿ handle in front of the title, or go onto it (Tab) and press Alt + ↑ / ↓. The order (for a video, an overlay, a text or a sound) and the open or closed sections are kept for next time. Display → “Right panel sections: ↺ Reset to default” puts everything back as before.
123uq49: Can I put an outline, a shadow or a band on the titles of the video editor?

Yes: choose the title, 🎯 Item tab. “🔤 Font and colour”: font (from the app or the computer), colour, bold, italic, shadow, band, fade. “✒️ Outline and shadow”: a coloured outline around the letters and its thickness, the colour and strength of the shadow. “▭ Band behind the text”: its opacity and rounded corners. “✨ Movement”: the entrance (fade, slide, typewriter…), the movement during and the exit; “📐 Duration, size and position”: the alignment and position. Everything looks the same in the exported video.
0hq8lz4: Where do I find all my montage, sound, retouching and layout projects?

Lists → 🛠️ Editing tools: one tab per tool (🎬 Video montage, 🎧 Sound, 🎚️ Photo retouching, 📐 Layout). Search by name, sort (newest, oldest, A → Z, Z → A), open, rename (✎) or delete (🗑) a project, or start a new one.
1nijdbl: How do I rename, resize or change the format of several images (or documents) at once?

Lists → 🛠️ Editing tools → “⚙️ Batch processing” → “＋ New process”: a kind of Automator. 1. The files: “🖼 Choose from media…” (several at once, with search and filters) or drag them from the computer: images, documents (Word, LibreOffice, RTF, Markdown, text, web page; PDF read-only), spreadsheets (Excel, LibreOffice, CSV) and sounds. 2. The actions, as stacked cards that you order with ⠿ (or Alt + ↑ / ↓), switch off with the toggle, duplicate (⧉) or remove (×): Rename (a text, a sequence 001, 002…, the date, the title, the person or the place, find / replace, capitals, without accents), Resize (longest side, width, height, percentage, without enlarging), Crop, rotate, mirror, Black and white, Watermark, Change format (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF; .docx, .odt, .rtf, .md, .html, .txt; .xlsx, .ods, .csv; MP3, WAV, FLAC), Quality and size, Erase metadata (GPS position…), Tags and person, Combine into one PDF. 3. “Here is what will happen” shows each name, size and format before → after; choose the result (new version of the media item, the original staying in its versions; copy in the media; or ⤓ a ZIP) then “▶ Run”. In the database, “↶ Undo” puts everything back as before. Keep your chains in “💾 Saved recipes” (ready-made sets: Photos for the web, Rename in sequence, Scans to PDF…).
04wbwjb: Why does Retouch not show “Separate copy” and “Save without showing it”?

These buttons are for photos in the database: the retouch becomes a version of the photo, the original being kept. For an empty canvas or an imported photo, there is no original to keep: “🖼 Save the image in Media” and “⤓ Download” are enough, and “💾 Save the project” keeps the layers so you can continue.
1kenpyq: Where do I put the Retouch tool column?

Settings → “Montage, retouching, layout and sound” → 🎚️ Photo retouching: the tool column (➤ ⬚ ◯ 🪄 ⌗ 🖌 T…) next to the image, far left or far right, and the panel (Settings, Layers…) on the right or left. Then “Save”.
0nuu1u7: How do I order or hide the buttons of the layout workshop?

In the workshop, “⚙️ Customise” (top right), or Settings → “Montage, retouching, layout and sound” → Buttons and options → Editor “📐 Layout”: top menus, ↶ ↷, tools of the left column, tabs of the right panel and bottom bar, to tick and order with ↑ ↓. Open the workshop once so that the list fills up.
1wfaevo: How do I make layer groups in Retouch?

Layers → “＋ Group” (or Layer → New group), or “Group” (⌘G) to put the chosen layer into a new group. A group can contain layers and other groups, as many levels as you like. The simplest: grab the ⠿ handle of a row and drag it — above or below another item, onto the middle of a group’s row (or onto “empty group”) to put it inside, onto the Photo row to put it right at the bottom. Also: the 📁 menu of each row, ↑ ↓ for the order, ▾ to fold a group. A group has its own visibility, opacity, lock and mask. ✕ on a group deletes it but keeps everything it contains.
1xf260j: How do I put settings or filters in a layer (adjustment layer)?

Layers → “＋ Adjustment” (or, at the top of the Settings and Filters tabs, “＋ in an adjustment layer”): the sliders, the curve and the filters then adjust that layer (the banner at the top says what you are adjusting; “adjust the photo” to go back). It acts on everything below it; tick “only on …” so that it only affects the layer or group just below (like a Photoshop clipping mask). Put in a group, it only affects that group. It can be masked, dosed (opacity) and hidden like a layer.
1p9tb8z: How do I start from a blank image in Retouch?

Lists → Media → “Retouch” → “⬜ Blank canvas”: choose the size (screen, square, A4, postcard or your own) and the background (white, transparent or a colour). The canvas is added to Media and opens in Retouch, ready for layers, text and shapes.
0ip58vq: How do I crop or straighten a photo in Retouch?

Tool ⌗ (C): drag the handles of the frame or draw a new one, choose proportions (square, 4:3, A4…), rotate with “Straighten”, then “✓ Confirm” (or Enter). Escape cancels. Select menu → “Crop to selection” crops as tightly as possible.
01lfdqq: How do I hide part of a layer without erasing it (mask)?

Layers → 🎭 on the layer (or the photo): a mask is added and the brush paints into it, ⬛ to hide, ⬜ to show. Click the layer thumbnail to go back to the layer. “invert the mask”, “remove the mask”, or Select → “Mask” to make one from the selection.
1p8dsoe: How do I copy a whole area with the clone stamp?
Select the area (⬚ ◯ ➰ ✒︎ 🪄), take the clone stamp 🧬 and drag: a copy of the area lands where you let go. Without a selection, the stamp copies with a brush from the chosen spot (🎯 or ⌥ + click).
1num5mm: How do I write or draw shapes on a photo?

Tool T: click, type, Enter (bold, italic, white outline, computer fonts). Tool ⬜: rectangle, rounded rectangle, ellipse, line or arrow, empty or filled (⇧: square, circle, right angle). With ➤ you move them, ⌫ deletes them, double-click a text to rewrite it.
1fcsfpm: ✨ Filters tab (or Filter menu): blur, noise reduction, sharpness, clarity, grain and vignette, applied after the settings, also on the full-size saved image.
1x1kp9q: How do I set up the layout of boards (toolbar, inspector)?

Settings → Boards → “Menus and options” tab → “🧭 Board layout”: toolbar at the top, bottom or side, inspector on the right or left, button size, title shown or not. The ⚙️ button in a board leads straight there.
15m4ilv: How do I edit a block of a note on a subject?

The block’s ✎ flips it over, like a dashboard widget: title, width (1, 1/2, 1/3, 1/4, 2/3, 3/4: you see it straight away), colour and content, then Save or Cancel. “＋ Block” adds a card at the bottom of the note, already flipped over to its settings.
0birdcj: How do I hide the empty lines of a record’s Identity block?
At the bottom of the Identity block: “Hide on this record” or “Hide on all” (and “Show…” to go back). The setting for all records is also in Settings → Appearance → record blocks.
0mcl4el: How do I hide lists in the Lists menu?
Lists → “Reorder” (bottom left): it takes you to Settings → “Menus, column and lists” → “Lists” tab. The eye on each row hides or shows the list; drag or use ↑ ↓ for the order.
09vnvf3: How do I assemble sounds from scratch?
Lists → 🎧 Audio → “🎬 Montage”: choose a first sound, then “＋ Add a sound…”, cut, fades, volume… “Save” makes it a new sound in the list.
0d4g66u: How do I add criteria to a distribution (Charts → Statistics)?

Under “From … to … · Limit · Sex”, “＋ Criterion” adds as many criteria as you like, the same as in My lists and the Chart editor: name, occupation, tag, place, within … km of, had a marriage, number of children, my ancestors (Sosa), without source… The “not” box reverses a criterion, 🗑 removes it, “↺ Reset to default” removes them all. The statistic then only counts the records kept (and their events).
0nide0u: How do I see who is behind a bar of a distribution?

Click the bar (or column): a window shows the people counted, with a search, sorting by name or birth and a CSV export — as for a chart of your own. This works for surnames, first names, places and countries of birth, marriage and death, sexes, years of birth and death and age at death.
0bzth0w: How do I choose the starting filters of all distributions?

On a distribution, “⚙️ Default settings of distributions”: set the years, limit, sex and criteria, then “⭐ Keep these filters as default for all”. They are used at the start of each distribution; “↺ Back to default filters” puts them back, “No more default setting” starts again from all the data.
1mpuu44: How do I keep all my app settings, or move them to another computer?

Settings → Appearance, at the very bottom → “💾 Saved settings: the whole app”: “＋ Save current settings” and a name keep all the settings (appearance, lists and columns, your own charts and tabs, widgets, boards, animals, books, shortcuts…). “Apply” goes back to them (the screen reloads), ⋯ → “Export” makes a file of them, “⤒ Import” takes it up on another computer. Your data is never touched; what targets a specific record (root person, a record’s exception) and what is specific to this computer are not kept.
0bwczif: Do saved settings keep Designs to choose from, portraits, Accessibility and Simple mode?

Yes. “💾 Saved settings: Appearance” keeps everything about appearance: the design, Designs to choose from, portraits, the left column, menus, colours… “💾 Saved settings: the whole app” also keeps Accessibility, Simple mode settings and, for each list, its sort and the List or Cards view (not what you typed in the search). Never included, even in an exported file: the code to leave Simple mode, the person watching, hidden photos, the backup folder. A setting saved before these new features puts them back “As before”, without touching the Simple mode code; an old setting that contained the font, the dashboard or sets from Designs to choose from applies without error, those parts are simply ignored. An imported file is checked: anything unknown or damaged is left out.
1e89z1u: How do I keep or share my layout?

Settings → Appearance → “💾 Saved settings: Appearance”: give a name to the current settings (design, menus shown or hidden and their order, blocks, colours…), go back to them in one click, or send the file to another user who imports it in the same place.
1hm96hz: How do I show the tree without the risk of it being changed?
View-only mode (padlock at the top right) blocks any change; you leave it with your password.
1wkbejv: How do I know if there is a new version of LCNDA?

In the desktop app, LCNDA checks on its own at start-up (at most once a day) the latest version published on GitHub. If there is a newer one, a message at the bottom left says so: “⤓ Download”, “See what’s new”, “Later” or “Don’t tell me about this version again”. To check right away: Settings → Help → “🔄 Updates” → “🔍 Check for an update” (or the application menu: LCNDA on Mac, Help on Windows and Linux). Only the question “what is the latest version?” goes to GitHub: nothing from your genealogy, no identifier. To never check: “Check for updates: Never” on the same page. Nothing is shown in Simple mode or in View-only mode.
0axvgj3: How do I install a new version?

“⤓ Download” takes the right installer for your computer (Apple or Intel Mac as .dmg, Windows as .exe, Linux as AppImage or .deb depending on what you use), puts it in your “Downloads” folder with a progress bar, then checks its fingerprint (the SHA256SUMS.txt file published with the version): a damaged file is deleted. Then “↗ Open” and you install it yourself (nothing is replaced on its own, the installers are not signed): on Mac, drag LCNDA into “Applications”; on Windows, follow the installation. Your genealogy, media and settings do not move.
0frwv5b: Settings → Appearance (“Theme and colours”), at the very top: “🌐 App language”. Thirteen languages: français, English, Español, Deutsch, Italiano, Português, Polski, Nederlands, Čeština, Svenska, Dansk, Slovenčina, Norsk (bokmål); the choice is kept straight away on this computer (“↶ Undo” to go back), and can also be made on the first-launch screen. French remains the reference language: the other translations are made by an AI, not by a person. A banner reminds you of this at the bottom right, with “Report a mistake” (it opens “🐞 Report a problem”, already filled in with “translation”); it closes with a click on × and comes back with “Show the banner again”. For now, the app frame is translated (menus, left column, headers, list bar, common windows, dashboard, Settings); records, tools and the FAQ will follow. Your data (names, notes, places) is never translated.
1yk5ypm: How do I report a problem (a bug)?

Settings → FAQ / tutorial (or About, or “🔄 Updates”) → “🐞 Report a problem”, or the Help menu of the desktop app. Write what happened and what you expected. A technical report is attached, visible and editable: version, system, size of the database in numbers only, useful display settings and the last 50 errors caught. Names, dates, places and file paths are removed from the errors: nothing from your genealogy is in it. Then “📋 Copy”, “Open an issue on GitHub” (the message is ready) or “✉️ Write an e-mail” if an address is set in “🔄 Updates”. Nothing is sent without you.
1nwxnnn: The 🐞 button at the top right and the “Something didn’t work” banner

The 🐞 “Report a bug” button, at the top right, opens the same “🐞 Report a problem” window (you arrange or hide it in Settings → Appearance → “Top-right buttons”). When the app runs into a real error, a small banner also appears at the bottom right: “🐞 Something didn’t work. Do you want to report it?”. “Report” opens the window, already filled in with the screen and the error (with nothing from your family tree): all you have left to do is say what you were doing just before; × closes it. It comes back at most once per screen and per minute, never in simple mode, and sits above the languages banner if it is there. To stop seeing it: Settings → “🔄 Updates” → “Offer to report when something doesn’t work”. Nothing is sent without you.
1euociw: My database is very big (100,000 people): does the app stay fast?

Yes. It has been tried on a database of 100,000 people (13 generations, 340,000 events, 20,000 places): the list of people, the search (even phonetic), a record, the trees, the map and the lists open in less than a second. Big calculations (statistics, ✅ Database check, GEDCOM export) take a few seconds, with the spinning circle, and the Check is then kept as long as nothing changes. In Lists › Occupations, each occupation shows its first 24 people, then “See the next 24 ↓”. A very large GEDCOM import (100,000 people) takes about a minute.
0p6v7nt: How do I get back a record deleted by mistake?
Settings → Change log: a deletion is restored with everything that was attached. ⌘Z undoes the last change to a record.
05d3vw6: How do I use the spreadsheet?

Lists → 🛠️ Editing tools → “🧾 Spreadsheet”, then “＋ New workbook” (or “📋 Start from a template”). Click a cell and type: a number, a text, a record date (“about 1784”, “an II”), or a formula starting with “=” (=SUM(D2:D9)). While typing a formula, click or drag over cells to put them in; the list of functions opens from the first letters (Tab to complete). Sheets are at the bottom (＋, double-click to rename, right-click to duplicate or delete). In the bottom bar: on the left the sheet and the cell (with the sum, average and count of the selection — click to choose what is shown), in the middle some help, on the right the zoom. ↶ ↷ undo and redo everything; “💾 Save” puts the workbook in the list.
01zopp9: How do I enlarge the grid, change the font or set up the spreadsheet?

Zoom: bottom right [− 100 % ▾ +] (⌘+ and ⌘−, ⌘0 to fit the filled columns to the window, ⌘1 for 100 %, or ⌘ + mouse wheel); it is remembered from one time to the next. Font: the “Font” button in the toolbar (or Format → “Aa Font…”) opens the list of fonts of the app and of the computer; the box next to it gives the size (13 px at first); both also go into the Excel file. The column of icons to the left of the grid brings together 🔍 Find, ⚲ Filter, ↕ Sort, ƒ Function, Σ, 👤 Person, 📍 Place, 💬 Note, 📊 Chart, 🎨 Conditional formatting, = Show formulas and ◫ the right panel. “💾 Save ▾” offers a copy, a template or the export. File → “⚙️ Spreadsheet settings…”: each change is kept straight away (“↶ Undo” at the bottom left, “↺ Reset to default”).
12pn1mw: What formulas does the spreadsheet understand?

Formulas are written as in Excel in French, with “;” between the parts: SOMME, MOYENNE, NB, NB.SI, SOMME.SI, SI, SI.ERREUR, RECHERCHEV, RECHERCHEX, INDEX, EQUIV, CONCAT, GAUCHE, TEXTE, DATE, ANNEE, DATEDIF, ARRONDI, MEDIANE, UNIQUE, TRIER, FILTRE… English names work too (SUM becomes SOMME). For genealogy: AGE("vers 1784";"an II") → ≈ 10, ANNEE.ACTE("baptisé le 3 frimaire an XII") → 1803, SOSA.GENERATION(12) → 4. “≈” means that a date is approximate. An error (#DIV/0!, #NOM?, #BOUCLE!…) is explained in plain words under the formula bar, with the cell concerned. Insert → “ƒ Function…” shows the whole list.
1iwbrmt: Do my workbooks keep everything when I exchange them with Excel or LibreOffice?

Yes, for the most part. ⤓ Export → XLSX (Excel) or ODS (LibreOffice) keeps values, formulas (translated into English for Excel), sheets, bold, colours, widths, merges, frozen panes, range names, 💬 notes, validation (choice lists, numbers between two limits), the filter and, in XLSX, conditional formatting. ⤒ Import reads all this back in both directions. Specific to the app: the “👤 person” or “📍 place” cells from the database, record dates in validation, and genealogy functions (AGE, SOSA…), which go out as values. In a formula, Shift + arrows extends the range pointed at (A2 → A2:A4) and brackets forgotten at the end are closed on Enter.
18z5esu: How do I open an Excel, LibreOffice or CSV file in the spreadsheet?

In the spreadsheet: File → “⤒ Import a table…” (or “⤒ Import…” in the list of workbooks). .xlsx (Excel, Numbers), .ods (LibreOffice), .csv, .tsv and .json files are read: several sheets, formulas, bold, colours, widths and merges. For a CSV, the separator and the accents of an old Excel file are guessed. You can also paste a table copied from Excel or Google Sheets (⌘V in the grid). Damaged or booby-trapped files are refused.
134kgln: How do I export a workbook to Excel, LibreOffice, CSV or PDF?

“⤓ Export ▾” at the top of the spreadsheet: XLSX (Excel, Numbers), ODS (LibreOffice), CSV and TSV (the open sheet), JSON, PDF, 🖨 Print, or the tool’s own file. Formulas go out in English for Excel; those that do not exist elsewhere (AGE, SOSA…) go out with their result. In a CSV, a cell starting with “=” is protected so that no formula can slip in.
0klm63n: How do I sort, filter or clean up a transcription in the spreadsheet?

Data menu: “↕ Sort A → Z” (record dates are sorted by their date), “⚲ Filter” (the search and filter bar of the lists appears above the grid, with “N rows of M”), “Remove duplicates…”, “Split text into columns…” (“MARTIN Jean, 34 ans, laboureur” → 4 columns), “Data validation…” (a choice list, or a person or place from the database chosen with the usual picker, ⌘K). Everything can be undone with “↶ Undo”.
0dooby0: How do I make a chart from the spreadsheet figures?

Choose the range (for example Decade, Men, Women) then “📊 Chart ▾”: the spreadsheet suggests the types that suit the range (decades: the line first; age bands and two series: the pyramid; a single series: the pie chart…) and opens the diagram editor. The diagram stays linked to the range: at the top of its data, “🔗 Data: “Workbook” ! A1:C4 · kept up to date”. Change a figure in the workbook (or add a row just below) and save: the diagram redraws itself wherever it is placed. “Freeze them” cuts the link. The workbook is stored in the Spreadsheet along the way.
0kmtdqz: How do I edit the figures of a diagram, chart or board in the spreadsheet?

Wherever there are figures, a “🧾 Edit the data” button opens the spreadsheet full size, already set up with the right columns (the blue banner says what is expected): Diagrams (Data tab), Chart editor (“✍️ My own figures”), Presentation (Table and Chart objects), Boards (▦ Spreadsheet object: “🧾 Open in the spreadsheet”) and Collections (one-page spreadsheet). You have formulas, sorting, pasting from Excel… then “✓ Save and go back” sends everything back. A cell like “approx. 12” is counted as 12. The small quick grids remain for 5 rows.
07wzzy2: What is “🎯 Prepare for…” in the spreadsheet for?

Data menu → “🎯 Prepare for…”: choose where the data of the range is going (a diagram, a chart, a presentation, a board, a collection). The spreadsheet shows what that place expects and which column it found (✓), flags the cells to check (⚠️ “C7 contains “env. 12”: counted as 12”, with “See the cell”), makes a preview, then creates the thing. For a board or a collection, it copies the range: paste it (⌘V) where you want.
0bsydi8: How do I take a Spreadsheet workbook for a diagram?

In the diagram editor, Data tab: “🧾 Take a workbook from the Spreadsheet” (also at the top of “📋 Paste a table”). Choose the workbook with the picker, then the sheet and the range (by default the whole sheet), look at the preview, and choose “Copy once” or “Keep the link” (the diagram then follows the workbook).
03s23d4: I only see 400 rows in the data of a diagram: how do I see the others?

Under the table: “See the next N ↓” adds the following rows (editable like the others, colour included), “See all” adds them all, and “🧾 See all in the spreadsheet” opens everything in the spreadsheet. All rows count in the drawing.
1r5u58p: Where is the calculator, and how do I keep it open?

The 🧮 button at the top right (or ⇧⌘Y — Ctrl+Shift+Y on a PC —, the “Shortcuts” widget, or Lists → 🛠️ Editing tools → “🧮 Calculator”) opens a small window that floats above the app: it stays open while you change screens, and even over an input window (a record, an event), so you can calculate without closing anything. Drag its title to move it, the bottom right corner to enlarge it (double-click the title: back to its place). Escape clears the box, then closes the calculator. Three tabs: 🔢 Simple (big keys, tape, memory), 🧪 Scientific, 📈 Graphs. It is not the 🧮 Spreadsheet (tables of cells to keep).
082kblu: How do I use the calculator with the keyboard?

Type the calculation (12 × 3,5, 1/3 + 1/6, 2^10, √2…): it is redrawn neatly above (stacked fractions, powers, roots) and the result is shown in grey; Enter confirms it. A sign typed just after a result continues the calculation (“+ 8” becomes “ans + 8”). ↑ ↓ bring back earlier calculations; a click on a line of the tape takes back its result, ✎ takes back the calculation to edit it, 📋 copies it (⌘C with nothing selected copies the result). MC MR M+ M−: the memory. An error is explained in plain words under the box (“A closing bracket is missing”) and the cursor goes to the faulty spot. Fractions stay exact (1/3 + 1/6 = 1/2, the decimal value below); 200 + 10 % = 220.
1iz21j7: What can the scientific calculator do?

🧪 Scientific tab, sections above the keys (each section has examples to click): trigonometry in degrees, radians or grads (DEG RAD GRAD), hyperbolic functions, ln, log, exp, π, e, φ; complex numbers (3 + 4i, modulus, argument, conjugate, √(−4) = 2i); gcd, lcm, C(n ; k), A(n ; k), prime numbers and factors(360) = 2³ × 3² × 5, rounding; binary, octal, hexadecimal (255 in binary, 0xFF); statistics on a list [12 ; 15 ; 9] (mean, median, standard deviation, quartiles); matrices [[1 ; 2] ; [3 ; 4]] (det, inverse, product, or “▦” to write them in a grid); equations up to the 4th degree typed with “=” (x^2 − 3x + 2 = 0, with the exact value ± √…) and systems resoudre(2x + y = 3 ; x − y = 0); derivative, integral, limit, sum of a sequence. In French notation, the comma is for numbers (2,5) and “;” separates the numbers of a function: pgcd(12 ; 18). ⚙️ sets the theme, the angle, the number of digits, comma or point, fractions, the region for measures, with “💾 Saved settings”.
0i7fhx5: How do I convert toises, arpents or livres-sols-deniers?

In the calculator, write “3 toises en m”, “5 arpents en ha”, “12 pieds en m”, “2 toises 3 pieds en m”, “1 livre poids en g”, “785 deniers en livres” (→ 3 livres 5 sols 5 deniers), “81 livres en francs”, “100 °F en °C”, or use the “Units” section (Value, From, To). Old measures follow the region chosen in ⚙️ (Paris by default, Lyon, Brittany, Normandy, Burgundy, Provence, Lorraine, Alsace, Flanders): these are the same tables as Settings → Calendar / measures, given to 6 digits (“≈” when the value changed from one village to the next).
1wjcrn3: Can the calculator count with record dates?

Yes, like the date fields (C4): “3 frimaire an XII” gives 25 November 1803 and the day of the week; “14 juillet 1794 en républicain” gives 26 messidor an II; “7 mai 1925 → 8 décembre 1960” (or “du … au …”) gives the age or the gap: 35 years, 7 months and 1 day, i.e. 12,999 days. With an incomplete date (“1925 → 1960”), it gives a range. “Dates” section of scientific mode: two boxes ready to use. The French Republican calendar was only used from 22 September 1792 to 31 December 1805.
1jd6xzi: How do I plot a graph?

Calculator → 📈 Graphs tab: write y = sin(x), x^2/4 − 1… (up to 6 curves, each in its own colour; “＋ Add a curve”, × to remove one). Drag to move around, mouse wheel or [− 100 % +] to zoom, hover over a curve to read x and y; “⤓” downloads the image (PNG). Curves are calculated in radians. A wrong formula is explained under its line.
087c7h1: How do I open a list or a statistic in the spreadsheet?

Above a list (Lists): “⤓ Export ▾” → “🧾 Open in the spreadsheet” (the columns and filters shown) or “As CSV”. For one of My charts, a list of artists or a diagram: “⤓ Export” → “🧾 Spreadsheet”. The workbook opens without being stored: “💾 Save” keeps it in the Spreadsheet.
1vybl9i: How do I fill the spreadsheet with data from my genealogy?

In the spreadsheet: Data → “⤒ Fill from the app…”. 1. What to take: 👥 People or 📅 Events (with the usual bar: 🔍 Search, Filter ▾ by sex, Sosa, place of birth, tag, years), 🏠 Censuses (a municipality, a year), 📜 Index transcriptions, 📈 Statistics (first names, occupations, ages at death…) or 📋 My lists. 2. The columns: order them with ⠿, remove them with ✕, “＋ A column taken from the data” adds one (father, mother, spouse, nationality…). 3. The preview, then “Where” (new sheet or from the chosen cell) and “⤒ Fill N rows”. People and places arrive as chips linked to their record; an empty cell in these columns is filled with the picker. “🔒 Without the living or confidential records” leaves them out (always in View-only mode).
0sy22df: What does “Keep up to date” mean in the spreadsheet?

If the “🔗 Keep up to date” box is ticked when filling, the sheet stays linked to your database: a green banner “🔗 Kept up to date” shows it, with “↻ Reload”. It is read again on its own each time the workbook is opened (and when you click ↻): new records added, deleted records removed, names and dates corrected. Columns you add on the right (a formula, a note) stay on their person’s row, even if the order changes. ⋯ → “Stop keeping up to date” keeps the values as they are. In all workbooks, a person or place chosen in a cell follows its record (new name); a deleted record becomes a grey “?” chip again.
1mh8uiw: How do I turn a transcription (census, register) into records?

In the spreadsheet: Data → “📤 Send to the database…” (or the button in the transcription’s banner). 1. The columns: what it creates (👤 records, 🏠 a census with its households, 📅 events) and, for each column, where it goes (Surname, First name, Age, Occupation, Relation to head…, guessed from the headings). 2. “Here is what will come in”, row by row: ALREADY IN THE DATABASE (the record is linked), NEW RECORD, TO CHECK (several possible records: choose ▾ the right one, a new record, or leave the row), PROBLEM (impossible age, missing name…: the row is left out). 3. “📤 Create N records and link N”: everything comes in at once; for a census, each household becomes a census of the municipality, the wife and children of the head are linked as a family. The message at the bottom left offers “↶ Undo”: everything just created is removed and the database is as before.
1bea6q5: How do I prepare a census transcription with the right columns?

Spreadsheet → “📋 Start from a template” → “🏠 Census transcription”. The banner at the top lets you choose the year (1836 → 1936): the columns change with it (age and calculated “Born about” until 1901; year and place of birth, nationality, employer after that); rows you have already typed stay under the same heading. Choose the municipality with the place picker, type the transcription, then “📤 Send to the database…”. From Lists → 📜 Record indexes, “🧾 In the spreadsheet” opens the people and households of a page (street, no., household, surname, first name, age, occupation, relation), kept up to date; sending links each transcribed person to their record. In the Research workshop, “Add an item from the software” → “🧾 A workbook” puts a workbook (budget, schedule, table of sources) in a folder of the project, and Export → “🧾 Table of all items, in the spreadsheet” opens it right away.
1pw64o1: How do I make my family website (without knowing how to code)?

Lists → 🛠️ Editing tools → “🌐 My website” → “＋ New site”: choose a template (My family, My ancestor, My village, Artist portfolio, Blank page). On the left, “＋ Blocks”: drag a header, a banner, a text, an image or a gallery (image window), and the blocks from your genealogy (tree, record, timeline, map, figures, photos of a person, people of a place) into the preview. “T Write”: click in a text to change it. “🎨 Styles”: colours, fonts, width. 🖥 💻 📱: the preview on a computer, tablet or phone. 💾 Save (⌘S) stores it in the list, with its versions.
0lp75i2: How do I link my code to the visual site (“this is my header”)?

In “🌐 My website”, “◫ Both” shows the preview and the code side by side: click an element of the preview, it says what it is (“This is: header.site-entete”) and its lines light up in the code; click in the code, the element is selected in the preview. On the right, give it a role with one click (Header, Menu, Main content, Section, Footer, Card), a name, a tag, a class, an id. Typing in the code updates the preview straight away; writing in the preview updates the code. Tab expands an abbreviation: ul>li*3, div.carte>h2+p, m10 → margin: 10px;.
14xnsa2: Does my website show living people?

No. The genealogy blocks (tree, record, timeline, map, figures, photos) follow the rule of “📤 Share with the family”: no living person and no confidential record, and a photo only goes out if nobody hidden is linked to it. If you have written by hand the full name of a living person, it becomes “[name removed]” in the exported site (the export window says so beforehand).
11cchor: How do I put my website online?
