In “🌐 My website”: “⤓ Export ▾” → “📦 The whole site as .zip” gives a .zip (index.html, the pages, css/, js/, images/ reduced and without GPS data, and a README). Unzip it and open index.html to see it; to put it online, send the whole folder to your web host (OVH, o2switch, Netlify, GitHub Pages…). “🌐 This page only” gives a single .html file, everything inside. “↗ Preview” opens it in a browser tab, like a visitor.
18k5egh: Where do I put my JavaScript in My website, and is it safe?

In the “Site JS” tab of the code. It only runs in “▶ Test” (an isolated preview that only sees your site, never the app or your database) and in the exported site (js/script.js). A script tag written in the HTML of a page is removed when saving, like onclick attributes and javascript: links: the message says so.
1qu311b: How do I move a block or an element of my website?

In “🌐 My website”, tool ↖ Select: take the element in the preview and drag it; a blue line shows where it will go (before, after, or inside with dotted lines when you aim at the middle of a section). With the keyboard: select it, then Alt + ↑ or Alt + ↓. The code follows on its own, and ↶ Undo puts it back.
0wtfdo4: How do I put one of my diagrams on my website?

In “🌐 My website”: ＋ Blocks → “🏛️ Diagram” → “One of my diagrams” (the picker) or “Create a diagram”. It is drawn by Charts → My diagrams with today’s figures, redrawn each time the site is opened, and frozen on export (the names of living people are removed). On the right: “✎ Edit the diagram”.
0zzubfv: How do I open my website on another computer, with MAMP, WAMP or XAMPP?

In “🌐 My website”: “⤓ Export ▾” → “📦 The whole site as .zip” (site-name-YYYY-MM-DD.zip). Unzip it wherever you like: a double-click on index.html is enough (pages, photos, scripts and the interactive map work without a server; the map background and Google fonts come from the Internet). With MAMP (Mac): copy the folder into htdocs, then http://localhost:8888/mon-site/. With WAMP: into www; with XAMPP: into htdocs, then http://localhost/mon-site/. Addresses are relative: it also works in a subfolder and with any web host. No need for PHP or a database. Everything is explained in LISEZ-MOI.html, in the .zip. As when publishing, no living person and no confidential record.
0812pbi: How do I change the style of all elements of the same kind on my website?

Choose an element in the preview: at the top of the right panel, “Apply to” offers “All .class elements” (the default when the element has a class) or “This element only”. With the class, your settings (colour, margins, size, alignment…) write a real rule in the site’s CSS, updated without duplicates: you see it change in the CSS tab, and what you type in the CSS comes back into the panel. “On hover” writes a :hover rule; “💻 Tablet” or “📱 Phone” writes the rule in an @media (and the preview switches to that size). ↶ ↷ undo and redo.
0mf4wnf: Does the interactive map of my site move in the editor?

Yes: in “🌐 My website”, a 🗺 map with “Interactive map” ticked can be moved (drag) and zoomed (＋ −, mouse wheel) directly in the preview, with the same small script and the same backgrounds as the exported site. A single click still selects it so you can set it up on the right.
1ypoyyp: How do I get a real map background on my website?

Choose the 🗺 Map block, then on the right “Map background”: the same list as Settings → Maps and base maps (Cassini, État-major, OpenStreetMap, satellite…). The map is made as an image with the credit of the background. “Interactive map”: in the published site, people can move it and zoom; it uses your background if allowed (OpenStreetMap, CARTO, OpenTopoMap, OpenHistoricalMap), otherwise the OpenStreetMap background; the image remains for anyone without JavaScript.
15ynmxw: How do I put my website online directly (Netlify, GitHub Pages, FTP)?

In “🌐 My website”: “📤 Publish”. Netlify: create a free account, then a token (User settings → Applications → Personal access tokens) and paste it. GitHub Pages: a “fine-grained” token with Contents and Pages permissions; the repository is created if it does not exist. Secure FTP: the server, username and password given by your web host; the connection is always encrypted. The token or password stays on this computer: it is never shown or backed up with the database; “× Forget” erases it.
16f4bjk: Can I put the calculator on the desktop?

Yes: 🪟 in the calculator’s bar, or Dashboard → “🪟 Desktop widgets…” → 🧮 Calculator. In the desktop app, it is a small separate window (always on top if you tick it); in a browser, a standalone .html file.
0a2774v: How do I put a widget on my computer’s desktop (PC, Mac, Linux)?

In the LCNDA desktop app: Dashboard → 🪟 on a widget (Today’s anniversaries, This week, Random person, Random image), or “🪟 Desktop widgets…” at the bottom of the column: On this day, An ancestor, Photo of the day, Countdown. A small frameless window, read-only; drag it by its title (it remembers its place); “Always on top” and “Start with the computer” are ticked in the same window; right-click on the widget: open LCNDA, remove it. In a browser, “⤓ Download the widget (.html)” gives a standalone file to keep in a tab (without living people).
009ft04: How do I write a letter, a story or a report in the app (the word processor)?

Lists → 🛠️ Editing tools → “📝 Word processor”, then “＋ New document” or “📋 Start from a template” (letter to the archives, request for a record, an ancestor’s story, visit report, research report, letter to the family, record transcription…). The text is written on real pages, with their margins: a paragraph that no longer fits moves to the next page. 💾 Save (⌘S) puts it in the list; “⚙️ Settings…” lets you save it on its own every few minutes.
0m2loal: Do my documents work well in Word, LibreOffice or pandoc?

Yes: ⤓ Export → Word (.docx), LibreOffice (.odt), RTF, Markdown, text or web page. Headings, bold, italic, colours, multi-level lists (the numbered list properly restarts at 1), tables with merged cells, images, notes, header and footer, landscape sections, comments and tracked changes are kept; RTF now writes real lists and vertical merges, and its accents are readable everywhere. ⤒ Import also reads files from Word, LibreOffice, Google Docs and pandoc (styles “Titre 1” or “Heading 1”, “List Bullet 2”, header of a previous section, YAML header of a Markdown file). ❓ Help (View menu) shows the answer over the document.
08k1ahi: How do I format text (styles, bold, lists, line spacing…)?

Choose a style on the left of the bar (Normal, Heading 1 to 6, Quote, Caption…): headings form the outline, the table of contents and the 🧭 panel. Bold ⌘B, italic ⌘I, underline ⌘U, strikethrough, superscript, subscript, small caps, font (the single font list), size, colour and highlight. Bulleted and numbered lists: Tab goes down a level, Shift+Tab goes back up, Enter on an empty line leaves the list. The right panel (🎨) sets alignment, line spacing, space before and after, indents, drop cap, border and shading.
1ofufze: How do I create my own styles, change style set or take those of a book?

Right panel → Styles: “＋ New style” starts from the paragraph at the cursor; “✎ Edit the style” changes all paragraphs of that style at once. “Style set” (Classic, Modern, Elegant, Archives, Very readable, Old book) changes the fonts and colours of headings and text. Format → “📐 Take the styles of a book…” copies the styles of a book from the layout.
1na62b8: How do I add an image, a table, a note or a link?

Insert menu (or the bar): 🖼 Image (the single image window; a pasted or dropped image also goes into the media), ▦ Table (rows, columns, repeated header row) or 🧾 Table from the Spreadsheet, 🔗 Link (⌘K), ¹ Footnote (⌥⌘F, it shows at the bottom of its page) or endnote. Click an image to resize it by a corner; right-click: inline, square (text around it), top and bottom, caption. Table menu: rows and columns, merge (drag from one cell to another), sort, borders, shading.
19q6ofg: How do I cite a person, a place or a source from my database in a text?

Insert → 👤 A person from the database (⇧⌘P): the usual picker, then what to write — the name (link to the record), the name and years, the birth or death with date and place. These texts follow the record: they are updated when the document is opened. 📍 A place, 🎞 A media item, 📖 a person’s biography (written by the app), 🌳 a small tree of 3 generations, 📊 a diagram. ❝ Cited source: the ready-made citation (4 styles), as a note; 📚 Bibliography picks it up on its own.
02yanze: How do I make a table of contents, an index or a bibliography?

Insert → 📑 Table of contents (based on Heading 1, 2, 3, with page numbers), 🔤 Index (the people, places and words marked with “Mark for the index”) or 📚 Bibliography (the cited sources). They redo themselves when the text changes; a click on a line of the table of contents takes you there.
1fwa9or: How do I set up the page: size, margins, orientation, header and footer, watermark?

Right panel → Page (or File → “📄 Size, margins and orientation…”): the app’s common sizes or “Custom size”, portrait or landscape, margins, page colour, watermark (DRAFT, COPY…). Double-click at the top or bottom of a page: the header and footer (page number, number of pages, title, date; different first page). Insert → “Section break”: what follows on a landscape page, for example for a large table; “▥ Columns” splits paragraphs into columns.
0vvqwbg: How do several people review a text: tracked changes and comments?

Tools → “✍ Track changes” (⌥⌘T): what is added is written in green underlined, what is deleted stays struck through in red, with the person’s name (Settings → “My name”). The ✍ panel lists the changes: ✓ Accept, ✗ Reject, or all at once. “Show changes”: all, simple or none. To comment: choose a passage then 💬 (⌥⌘M); you can reply, mark “Resolved”, delete (↶ Undo right after). Word and LibreOffice pick up the changes and the comments.
1dkz6l0: How do I find and replace a word in a document?

⌘F (or 🔍): the search bar, with “Aa” (match case), “Whole word” and “Simple patterns” (* = some letters, ? = one letter, # = one digit). Each match is highlighted and listed in the 🧭 “Results” panel. ⇧⌘H goes straight to replacing: “Replace” or “Replace all” (↶ Undo right after).
05ithxc: How do I open or save a Word (.docx) or LibreOffice (.odt) file?

Open: “⤒ Import…” in the list (or File → Import, ⌘O): Word (.docx), LibreOffice (.odt), RTF, Markdown, text or web page; the window says what will come in before importing. Save: “⤓ Export ▾” at the top: Word, LibreOffice, PDF, RTF, Markdown, text, web page, or the tool’s own file; “Also store a copy in the media” keeps the .docx with the other documents. Everything is done in the app, with no extra software; a booby-trapped file (too big, zip bomb, XML with declarations, scripts) is refused or cleaned.
0gmiwp5: How do I print or make a PDF of a document?
“⤓ Export ▾” → 📄 PDF or 🖨 Print (⌘P): each page comes out exactly as on screen, with the header, footer, footnotes and watermark. For the PDF, choose “Save as PDF” as the printer.
13oxi7s: How do I keep versions of a document and compare them?

File → “🕘 Save as new version” keeps the text as it is. File → “🕘 Versions…” opens the versions window: click a version to see it on the right, tick two versions (or “Now”) to compare them (removed words struck through in red, added ones in green), “↺ Go back to this version” (the current text is kept first, ↶ Undo possible).
00nftru: Where do I find older versions (text, site, photo, sound, montage, board)?

The same “🕘 Versions” window everywhere: File → “🕘 Versions…” in the word processor, My website, Retouch, Sound studio and the montage; “🕘 Versions…” under the photo or sound in quick retouch and Quick sound; “📸 Snapshots” in a board. At the top, “All / ✎ Named / 🕘 Automatic”; the list is grouped by Today, This week, Older, with “Now” at the very top. Click a version to see it; tick two to compare them (text struck through / added, two sounds to listen to as A / B, two images with a line to drag). “↺ Go back to this version” asks nothing: what was there is kept first, and “↶ Undo” puts everything back. The ⋯ button of a version (or right-click): ✎ Rename, ⧉ Make a copy, ⤓ Export, 🗑 Delete (with “↶ Undo”). The original of a photo or sound is never deleted.
0agwo9k: How do I check a story against my records, count the words or listen to it?

Tools → “🔎 Check against the records”: the dates and places written near a name from the database are compared with that person’s record (birth, marriage, death, ages, Sosa numbers); nothing is changed on its own. “🔢 Word count” (also at the bottom left); the document’s language is used for spelling (words underlined, corrections on right-click) and for “🔊 Read aloud”.
15wjpne: How do I send a document into a book in the layout?

File → “📐 Send to the layout…”: a new book, or the end of an existing book. Heading 1 paragraphs become chapters, bold and italic stay, images get their own page with their caption, notes go into a “Notes” part. The layout remains the tool for composing the book; the word processor the one for writing.
01iy15f: How do I ask the family who is in a photo?

Open the photo (viewer) and click “📤 Ask who it is” (also: Lists → Media → 👤 Faces → “📤 Ask the family” on unknown faces, or Lists → 💬 Questions for relatives → “🔍 Who is in this photo?” → “＋ New request…” for several photos). Click the frames to choose the faces (or draw one with the mouse; “🔍 Find faces” looks for them on its own), choose the names to suggest, then “⤓ Download the file”. Your cousin opens it at home, without the app or the Internet: they click a face, write a name or choose it from the list, add a note, then “Save my answers”. The file only contains the photos, frames and names you chose: never a confidential record, never a living person unless you tick the box.
0pymcw2: How do I import my cousins’ answers about a photo?

Lists → 💬 Questions for relatives → “⤒ Import the answers” (the file “reponses-visages.json” sent back to you). For each face: the suggested name, who said it, the record to link (“Is it the same person?”, through the picker), and ✓ Accept / ✕ Refuse / Later. If several cousins answered, you see whether they agree (green “Agreement” chip) or not (red “Disagreement”). An accepted face becomes an identification on the photo; “↶ Undo” puts everything back as before.
08uqy7r: How do I write a letter to request a record?

On a record: “⋯” → “📮 Request a record…”; also in “What’s missing?” (“📮 Request the record” button on a missing birth, marriage or death) and in Lists → Letter register (“📮 Request a record”, “Prepare the letter” for recent records). Choose the record and what you are asking for (full copy, extract with or without parentage, search in the archives, transcription of a record abroad, dispensation file): the letter writes itself, with the person, the dates, the parents, your relationship and the recipient’s address (town hall, departmental archives, Central civil registry in Nantes, diocesan archives), which you can correct. The time-limit rule is explained: in France a birth or marriage record is freely accessible after 75 years; before that, the full copy is reserved for direct family. Then: 📝 word processor, 🖨 Print or ⤓ PDF, ✉️ e-mail ready (nothing is sent by the app), 📁 copy in the media, and “📮 Store in tracked letters” (with the reminder date, also in “My research week”).
0zl1jve: Where do I set my address and my letter templates?

In the “📮 Request the record” window, ⚙️ button at the top: your name, your address, your town, your e-mail, the reminder delay and the templates for each kind of letter (with placeholders like {personne}, {evenement}, {demande}). Everything is kept straight away; “💾 Saved settings” keeps several sets under a name.
0d498sh: Where do I find “Write about this person” and research reports?

On a person’s record, the 📝 button at the top opens a story already filled with their biography (also: 📖 Biography block → “Put in ▾” → word processor). In the Research log, “⋯” → “📝 Report” makes a document of the research shown; in archive visits, “📝 Report” on each mission sheet.
1ocafi3: How do I organise the family book?

Settings → Clean export → Family book: tick the parts (cover, preface, figures, tree, records, chronology, places, index, closing word) and order them; the same for what each record shows. Choose the style, font, page size, then the format: PDF (through printing), HTML, Word, OpenDocument, ePub (e-reader), Markdown, text or CSV.
0alpt3a: What is the layout workshop (InDesign style)?

Settings → Clean export → Family book → “Open the layout workshop”. It is a small InDesign for making the book of your genealogy: single pages or facing pages, masters (folio, running head), layers, text frames (computer font, size, leading, tracking, capitals, alignments, indents, drop cap, columns), shapes (rectangle, ellipse, polygon, star, line, pen), image frames, swatches and gradients, strokes, effects (opacity, blend, drop shadow, feather, rounded corners), text wrap, Pathfinder, align and distribute, links. You save, pick it up later, export.
1yh7tnm: Where do I find the books made in the layout workshop?

Lists → 📐 Family books: all the books and your designs, with their cover. Open, duplicate, rename, export, delete; at the top, “New book from the family”, “From a design”, “Blank page”, “Default settings” and the workshop.
0kzaksv: How do I start a book in the layout workshop?

In the workshop: “＋ New book from the family” (a branch, the parts you want, a design: the cover, one page per person with their photo, the chronology, the index… texts that are too long continue on the next page), “🎨 New from a design”, or “📄 Blank page”. You choose the size, the margins (top, bottom, inside, outside), the columns and gutter, the bleed and the baseline grid. “⚙️ Default settings” sets what new documents get.
1vjfmfd: What is a design in the layout workshop, and how do I make one?

A design is a template: cover, masters, paragraph and character styles, colours. The app offers six (Classic, Modern, Elegant, Sepia, Photo album, Plain): “Use” or “Edit (as my own)”. Your own design: open a book, then File → “🎨 Save as design”. The list shows the cover of each book and each design.
038sy3m: How do I add pages or go to a page in the layout workshop?

Page menu (or 📄 Pages panel): “＋ Page at the end”, “＋ Insert…” (as many pages as you want, before or after a given page, at the start or end, with the chosen master), duplicate, delete, move a page forward or back. To go to a page: the “Page” box at the bottom, ⌘J, or Page Up / Page Down on the keyboard.
1ldnesf: What are the shortcuts of the layout workshop?

V selection, T text, F image frame, M rectangle, L ellipse, Y polygon, E star, \ line, P pen (double-click or Enter to finish, click on the first point to close), H hand, Z zoom. ⌘Z / ⇧⌘Z undo and redo, ⌘C ⌘X ⌘V ⌘D, ⌘A, ⌫ delete, arrows to nudge (Shift: 5 mm), ⌘] ⌘[ bring forward and send backward, ⌘0 whole page, ⌘S save, W preview. Alt while dragging: a copy. Shift: proportions kept.
1y4wxrd: How do I export the book from the layout workshop as a PDF?

File → “⤓ Export as PDF (print)” opens the book ready to print: “Print”, then “Save as PDF”. For a printer: “PDF with bleed and crop marks”. Also: HTML page (photos included) and document file (.json) to keep or pass on to someone (“Import a document” in the workshop).
0emo7c0: How do I undo a change in the layout workshop?
↶ ↷ buttons at the top (or ⌘Z / ⇧⌘Z). The 🕘 History panel lists each change: a click on a step goes back to it, the following ones stay greyed out as long as you do nothing else.
1ec2pmg: How do I widen the right panel of the layout workshop or of Retouch?
Drag its left edge (the cursor becomes ↔) to the left to widen it, to the right to narrow it; the width is kept. Double-click the edge: starting size.
1lzss61: How do I create or change a master in the layout workshop?

📄 Pages panel → Masters: “＋ New master” (you give it a name), “Edit” to place what comes back on its pages (folio, rules…), “→ p. N” to apply it to the current page, “Page without master”, or “Detach items” to change on this page only what comes from the master.
0gz93h8: How do I put the colour I want on a text or an object in the workshop?

Text: choose the words, then 🅰 Text panel → Character → “Free colour” (the square opens all colours, or type a code like #7a2e2e; the circles are the swatch colours). Object: click the fill or stroke square at the bottom of the tools, the palette opens directly. ⇄ (or ⇧X) swaps fill and stroke, ⧄ (or /) empties them, X switches from one to the other.
0epbzrn: How do I make text flow around a photo (text wrap)?
In the layout workshop: choose the photo, 🔧 Object panel → “Text wrap”: around the frame, around the shape (ellipse) or jump object, and the distance. Neighbouring text frames flow past it.
0jc42lk: How do I import my tree from another program?
Settings → Import → “⤒ Import a tree…”: GEDCOM file (also from Ancestry, MyHeritage, Geneanet, FamilySearch), Gramps (.gramps or .gpkg), Hérédis (.hmw), GedZip or MacFamilyTree.
0al4nig: How do I add a cousin’s tree to my database?
Settings → Merge a tree: their GEDCOM is compared with yours, then you decide record by record.
10d4pfr: How do I make a family book as a PDF?

Settings → Clean export → Family book: the whole database, or the ancestors and/or descendants of a person over the number of generations you want, with the tree generation by generation, the biographies, the photos and the chronology. “Open for printing” then “Print / save as PDF”.
1g1z8gf: How do I export only one branch?
Settings → Clean export: choose the starting person and the ancestors or descendants to export.
